content:
jamie: Heads-up: ops found a small but visible class of customer complaints - requests that should have hit v2 landed on v1 during yesterday's quota enforcement window. Not all cases look identical.
olga: ugh. any quick reproduction/lines in logs?
jamie: snippet from the edge collector (sanitized):
```
[2025-05-10T22:14:03Z] req=5f7 route=org/omega intended_variant=v2 status=THROTTLED reason=RATE_CAP fallback=org/omega:v1 decision=prefers_stability -> selected=org/omega:v1
```
jamie: Note decision bit `prefers_stability` 111 - that's our circuit-breaker logic that chooses the historically-stable variant under stress.
samir: I thought fallback_variant was supposed to win for capacity reasons. Why is prefers_stability able to override explicit fallback?
pete: That was deliberate during earlier rollouts to avoid oscillation when transient errors hit newer variants, but we didn't scope it to keep the fallback semantics intact for RATE_CAP. Looks like an oversight.
anna: From product/console POV tenants didn't get any signal. They just see worse results. We need both better telemetry and a UX affordance to explain why traffic shifted.
olga: Technical plan: two fixes - (A) switch precedence so explicit `fallback_variant` wins when reason==RATE_CAP; (B) split the circuit-breaker decision: a separate stability path only applies when reason==ERROR, not RATE_CAP. I'll prototype the branch today.
samir: Telemetry: propose emitting `routing.fallback.count` with tags {route,from_variant,to_variant,reason}. Also emit `routing.fallback.path` as a low-rate sampled event with `decision_stack` showing the chain (e.g., [rate_cap, prefers_stability, sticky]). That way we can apportion blame. Sample at 0.2% for path events.
pete: Important: pick metric names carefully to avoid explosion in dashboards. Use `routing.fallback.count` (1m rollup) + `routing.fallback.paths.sampled` (0.2%). Keep `reason` enumerated to {rate_cap, error, header_norm, sticky, circuit_breaker}.
jamie: Console changes: show a per-route microtile: "Fallbacks (1h)" with breakdown by reason and a small sparkline. On incidents surface a banner: "X% of requests routed to fallback variant v1 due to capacity controls" with a CTA: "View details" linking to sampled examples and recommended remediations.
anna: For customer communication: automatic email only if fallback_rate > 5% sustained for 15m. In banner dynamics include suggested actions: increase reserved capacity, request dedicated route, or accept fallback. Keep copy short and actionable.
olga: Rollout plan: ship router precedence fix behind `router.fallback_prec_e2` flag; canary in prod-1 -> monitor `routing.fallback.count` and `routing.fallback.paths.sampled`. We'll also run a shadow experiment called `shadow_fallback_mode` where we simulate fallback decisions without changing live routing for 1% of traffic.
samir: Good. Also add a smoke test that sends varied header forms to detect header normalization causing variant mismatch. We saw gateway proxies lowercasing or stripping hyphens in headers before.
pete: Owners & ETA: olga -> PR + unit tests (ETA: today EOD), samir -> metric registration + sampling config (ETA: tomorrow AM), anna -> console mock + banner wording (ETA: tomorrow AM), jamie -> ops saved query and initial outreach (ETA: today).
canary-bot: Deployment scheduled: olga/router-fallback-precedence -> canary prod-1 at 2025-05-11T02:40:00Z. Shadow experiment `shadow_fallback_mode` -> enabled on prod-canary cohort at 2025-05-11T03:00:00Z.
olga: I'll add the decision-stack header in logs when feature flag enabled so sampled events include the chain. Keep logs gated to 0.1% sample to avoid noise.
samir: After canary, run a replay using recorded traffic from the incident window and compare routing outcomes with/without fix. Should help confirm no regressions.
jamie: Ops: please abort canary if fallback counts spike > 2x baseline or if any customer-facing errors increase.
anna: UX nuance: for customers on Dedicated we should expose a console toggle "Prefer no-fallbacks" that honors tenant-level policy (may increase latency/failures). We'll surface that as an advanced setting.
pete: Billing note: we should ensure fallback attribution for billing is unchanged (i.e., tokens served by v1 still billed correctly). samir: will ensure metrics pipeline tags include `billing_variant` equal to selected_variant.
olga: Quick checklist posted to ticket and PR description. I'll ping infra for extra observability if canary looks flaky.
jamie: Thanks. Reopen if canary throws anything unexpected.
